text:
GENERATE BURST CS-vfx-pconc-sheets — greyscale PAINTED-PIXEL effect sheets for POISONOUS CONCOCTION (breadth test kit 3: poe1-pconc; style card v0.2). task_id "CS-vfx-pconc-sheets".

Paint ONE 1536×1024 image on flat PURE BLACK #000000 — the background is a BLACK VOID: NO grey fog, NO gradient, NO vignette, NO atmosphere, NO lighting on the background; every background pixel is exactly #000000 (this is the one hard rule; a grey or hazy background is a failed image). The flask glass is drawn MID GREY so it stays visible against black. a 6-column × 4-row grid of 256×256 cells (each effect drawing centred in its cell, never touching the cell edge), GREYSCALE ONLY (light grey → mid grey → dark grey → darker grey (use pure WHITE only for the tiniest fuse spark and the very centre of the flame cores, never for whole shapes), no colour), in a PAINTED-PIXEL register: each drawing looks like a hand-painted sprite at a small native size — hard-edged shapes, 3–4 flat value steps, a near-white core, dark grey rim/interior holes, ABSOLUTELY NO soft gradients, NO glow, NO haze, NO bloom, NO radial light falloff around any shape, NO blur, NO anti-aliasing, NO outline strokes: every pixel is one of exactly FIVE values — pure black background, dark grey #404040, mid grey #808080, light grey #C0C0C0, pure white #FFFFFF — with hard, stair-stepped edges as if drawn with a 1-px pencil at 64 px and scaled up 4x with nearest-neighbour. Think 1990s 16-bit sprite effects (Diablo I / Secret of Mana spell sprites) drawn in greyscale, NOT a modern glowing render. If you are tempted to make anything glow, draw a ring of light-grey pixels instead. Design it as a thrown poison-flask effect (a small round flask, thick bubbling liquid, a bursting puddle of caustic poison with fat bubbles and rising droplets, a lingering bubbling pool) even though it is greyscale.
ROW 1 — CAST (6 frames, left to right in time): a small flask of thick liquid raised and shaken, bubbles rising inside it and a few droplets flicking off; frame 6 the flask is released, tilted, liquid sloshing.
ROW 2 — TRAVEL (6 frames): the flask tumbling in flight drawn facing RIGHT, liquid sloshing inside, a short trail of droplets to the LEFT; each frame a different rotation so they loop.
ROW 3 — IMPACT (6 frames): the flask bursts: frame 1 a low flat splash of thick liquid with glass shards (no white disc); then fat bubbles swell up from the puddle; then a wide low burst of bubbles popping with droplets flung outward; the last frame is a few bursting bubbles and drips.
ROW 4 — RESIDUAL + DROPLET (6 frames): frames 1–4: a wide flat bubbling pool on the ground (an ellipse wider than tall, bubbles rising and popping along it) in four looping variations of the same size; frames 5–6: one single fat droplet facing RIGHT with a tiny trail, two variants.
Every drawing must read at 25 % size (64 px cells). Nothing between cells; no labels, grid lines, text or border; background pure black.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if colour appears, any glow/haze/gradient appears, cells bleed into each other, or a row is missing — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/pconc_sheets.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-vfx-pconc-sheets"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
